narr: On April 15th, south of a nearly stationary front, a couple of isolated thunderstorms developed over north central Kentucky. One of these storms remained almost stationary over Oldham County. This produced severe hail, tree damage, and flash flooding over a relatively small area.
ev: A street was impassable due to flowing water. A vehicle attempted to pass and was pushed off the road.
